title: Rav Kahana bar Malkiyah
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: In Jerusalem Talmud Berakhot 6:1, folio 40b, he speaks in Rav’s name. In Yuchasin, 8b, they said that he was Rav’s teacher. Hyman also finds in Bereshit Rabbah 31:7: Rabbi Huna and Rabbi Yirmeyah in the name of Rav Kahana bar Malkiyah.[^1][^2]

notes.text: The Midrash Rabbah — TE digital Bereshit Rabbah 31:7 fully writes Rav Kahana bar Malkiyah, supporting ר״כ. Hyman’s report of Yuchasin’s teacher claim and his statement that Kahana reports Rav in the Jerusalem Talmud are both retained, without reversing either relationship.

The checked Jerusalem Talmud Berakhot 6:1 has Kahana bar Malkiyah reporting Rav, without an explicit title at that occurrence. Bereshit Rabbah 31:7 fully writes Rav Kahana bar Malkiyah in the report of Rabbi Huna and Rabbi Yirmeyah. The teacher claim attributed to Yuchasin has not been directly collated; it is retained alongside Hyman’s opposite-direction transmission report, without resolving the relationship.
